load_data: load processed enrichment factor data for a given generation as a pandas DataFrame
load_all_data: load and concatenate processed enrichment factor data across all generations g1 through g4
get_bootstrapped_hit_rate_stats: compute bootstrapped hit rate mean and standard deviation grouped by sublibrary name
select_hit_rows: filter a DataFrame to rows identified as hits using FDR-controlled multiple testing
expand_sublibraries: expand a DataFrame so each row is replicated once per sublibrary name in its sublibrary_names column
